Burnaby condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for apartments (condos) in Burnaby was $708,100 in September 2026 (-5.5% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.

blocks.source: Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS®, MLS® Home Price Index, September 2026 (released October 2, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Burnaby East: the apartments (condos) benchmark was $708,100 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 5.5%; over three months it was little changed (-0.2%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over the last month it was little changed (+0.1%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 11.5%; over 5 years it was little changed (-0.4%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over 10 years it rose 31.5%. Burnaby North: the apartments (condos) benchmark was $662,400 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 6.6%; over three months it fell 2.4%; over the last month it was little changed (-1.1%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 12.9%; over 5 years it was little changed (-1.3%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over 10 years it rose 43.2%. Burnaby South: the apartments (condos) benchmark was $723,000 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 8.3%; over three months it fell 2.2%; over the last month it was little changed (-1.2%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 14.5%; over 5 years it fell 1.5%; over 10 years it rose 33.1%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

blocks.text: Before you buy condos in Burnaby
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a condo in Burnaby?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for apartments (condos) in Burnaby (Burnaby East) was $708,100 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did condo prices fall in Burnaby?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 5.5%. Over three months it was little changed (-0.2%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Burnaby a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Burnaby had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Burnaby?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the condos in Burnaby that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when condos come up in Burnaby?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Burnaby homes?
faq.a: The Burnaby homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Burnaby market stats page has the monthly figures.
Jared is a REALTOR® and Personal Real Estate Corporation with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, working across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. You can call or text him at 604-928-1361.
